reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`experimental.ruler.enable-api` is removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Configuration under `experimental.ruler.enable-api` will no longer be honored; the setting must be moved to `ruler.enable-api`.

proposed.statement: The `experimental.ruler.enable-api` configuration option is removed in Loki 3.0.0; users must migrate to `ruler.enable-api` instead.
